plugin.note: Wear Reinforced goggles (or a Slayer helmet after A Porcine of Interest) to negate the caustic saliva, then use a stab weapon: the Sourhog's Defence is +0 to stab and +0 to ranged but +30 to slash and +30 to magic.

requirements: Quest A Porcine of Interest to access Sourhog Cave; no combat or Slayer level requirement.
Reinforced goggles or a post-quest Slayer helmet to avoid the 20-30 caustic hit and 90% Attack/Defence drain.
mechanics: The Sourhog has 40 Hitpoints, Defence level 25, a normal max hit of 6 and a 5-tick attack.
Without eye protection its caustic saliva hits 20-30 and drains Attack and Defence by 90%.
No elemental weakness; +0 stab and +0 ranged Defence make stab and ranged the most accurate.

methods.label: Stab melee with goggles
methods.summary: Wear Reinforced goggles (or a post-quest Slayer helmet) and attack with a stab weapon such as a dragon dagger.
steps: Start A Porcine of Interest and enter Sourhog Cave south of Draynor.
Equip Reinforced goggles (or a Slayer helmet after the quest) so the caustic saliva cannot land.
Attack the Sourhog with a stab weapon; its Defence is +0 to stab versus +30 to slash.
notes: Bring a little food; the normal max hit is only 6 with goggles on.

methods.label: Ranged
methods.summary: Shoot the Sourhog with a bow to exploit its +0 ranged Defence while keeping eye protection on.
recommendedFor: players who prefer ranged or want distance
steps: Attack the Sourhog from range; its +0 ranged Defence makes arrows accurate.
notes: Ranged avoids being adjacent but the caustic attack still requires goggles.
